extracted.intended_audience: researchers, performer teams, companies, and other organizations interested in applying to ARPA-H funding opportunities
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting proposals and engaging as a performer with the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health (ARPA-H), including solicitation mechanisms, program expectations, contracting instruments, and programmatic priorities. Focuses on what ARPA-H looks for, required team composition, milestone expectations, and how projects progress toward commercialization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Innovative Solution Opening (ISO) solicitation requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H typically employs a solicitation mechanism called an Innovative Solution Opening (ISO). The ISO contains the technical requirements for proposals, including key dates and deadlines, eligibility and teaming information, examples of in- or out-of-scope work, evaluation criteria and other metrics, and application templates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Find ISOs on SAM.gov by searching for 'ARPA-H' or by the specific effort's name or notice ID. Carefully follow the ISO's technical requirements, deadlines, eligibility/teaming rules, examples of scope, evaluation criteria, and templates when preparing submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand and plan for Other Transactions (OTs) contracting
rubrics_metrics.description: Contract awards are usually in the form of Other Transactions (OTs), which are not procurement contracts, grants, or cooperative agreements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OTs allow for flexible contracting and negotiations. Applicants should understand OT implications for terms, reporting, and negotiation. See the Other Transaction Community for more detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the Solution Summary then full Proposal pathway
rubrics_metrics.description: The competitive application process typically involves submission of a Solution Summary (a short abstract) followed by a full Proposal, if your submission receives encouraging feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare a concise Solution Summary that clearly conveys the idea; be ready to expand into a full proposal only if invited/encouraged. Treat the Solution Summary as a primary screening artifact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form multidisciplinary teams including non-traditional collaborators
rubrics_metrics.description: Program Managers (PMs) expect researchers to establish multidisciplinary teams to reach the ambitious goals of their programs. Collaborators might be from fields outside traditional biomedicine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assemble teams that combine diverse expertise necessary to meet ambitious, cross-cutting technical goals; explicitly justify team composition in relation to program objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propose revolutionary, high-impact work (avoid basic/incremental/educational/infrastructure)
rubrics_metrics.description: Importantly, ARPA-H seeks revolutionary work that demonstrates either cutting-edge proof of concept or establishes market readiness, depending on the ISO. Basic research, incremental improvements, educational programming, and infrastructure are not part of ARPA-H’s focus areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame proposals to emphasize breakthrough potential, radical innovation, or clear path to market-readiness per the ISO. Do not position work as incremental, purely basic research, education, or infrastructure provisioning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide cutting-edge proof-of-concept or market readiness per ISO
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H seeks revolutionary work that demonstrates either cutting-edge proof of concept or establishes market readiness, depending on the ISO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Align the project's stated deliverables and milestones with whether the ISO requests proof-of-concept demonstration or market-readiness evidence; provide concrete metrics and evidence appropriate to the ISO's expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on platform technologies with broad, cross-indication impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Rather than focus on particular diseases, the agency seeks high-impact platform technologies that might have applications across indications. Furthermore, ARPA-H explores unexpected solutions that might not be traditionally considered in biomedical research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize generalizable platforms or approaches that can be applied across multiple conditions or use-cases and highlight novel/nontraditional approaches when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align with Health Science Futures Office priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Health Science Futures Office is interested in restoring healthy function through repair and regrowth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed solutions might include computational modeling of biology, AI platforms, regenerative medicine, and robotics—tailor proposals to show how they restore function, enable repair/regrowth, and fit this Office's mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align with Proactive Health Office priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Proactive Health Office seeks to prevent people from becoming patients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals could include unique delivery methods of personalized healthcare or population-level approaches to boost adoption of healthy behaviors; demonstrate prevention impact and scalability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align with Resilient Systems Office priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Resilient Systems Office is interested in improving robustness, both of healthy bodies and the healthcare system overall.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on interoperability, digital platforms for secure data management, and approaches to mitigate disruptions to healthcare access; show system-level resilience benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align with Scalable Solutions Office priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Scalable Solutions Office seeks to address the technical barriers that prevent interventions from reaching as many people as possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address novel biomanufacturing, economies of scale, last-mile delivery, or other technical barriers to scale; show clear paths to scaling and population-level impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be prepared to negotiate and modify proposal terms if selected
rubrics_metrics.description: If selected for negotiations, you’ll negotiate the project terms and conditions with ARPA-H. Depending on the ISO’s details, you may be asked to modify your original proposal to account for adjusted budgets, milestones, or timeline(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect iterative negotiation with Program Managers and contracting teams; maintain flexibility in budgets, milestone definitions, and timelines and plan contingency approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliver against milestone-based payments with regular progress demonstrations
rubrics_metrics.description: Since most ARPA-H agreements involve milestone-based payments, you must regularly demonstrate progress against the deliverables outlined in the agreement. PMs work closely with performer teams to evaluate progress and troubleshoot research roadblocks. If a result fails to measure up, a performer’s work may be adjusted or stopped.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design measurable, time-bound milestones and data-driven go/no-go criteria; document progress clearly and be prepared for close PM engagement, adjustments, or termination if milestones are not met.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan for program duration and transition to external support/commercialization
rubrics_metrics.description: Most programs and other efforts run for two to six years. ARPA-H expects that successful research projects that ‘graduate’ from the agency will find support elsewhere. The ARPA-H Office of Commercialization (OC) is designed to help successful solutions ‘survive in the wild.’
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Build a transition/commercialization strategy into project plans, including regulatory pathway considerations, VC engagement, and entrepreneurial training; engage ARPA-H OC resources when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitor limited-time opportunities and use agency communication channels
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H Programs are open for a limited time, so be on the lookout for new funding opportunity announcements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscribe to the Vitals newsletter, follow ARPA-H on X/Twitter and LinkedIn, and regularly check SAM.gov and ARPA-H submission resources to avoid missing short open windows.
